supporting.title: Three slow breaths before you open messages
Name one good thing before bed

days.title: Do box breathing for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Slow, even breaths can calm your body.

days.title: Sit somewhere quiet for {minutes} minutes and just notice your breath
days.reason: A short pause can lower stress.

days.title: Write down what is on your mind for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Writing worries down can make them feel smaller.

days.title: Listen to calm music for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Calm music can help you slow down.

days.title: Call or message someone you trust for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Talking with someone can ease stress.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes on something you enjoy
days.reason: Doing something you like is good for your mind.

days.title: Do slow breathing for {minutes} minutes and notice how you feel
days.reason: Noticing calm moments helps you find them again.
